requirements.requirement: A bachelor's degree equivalent to a Swedish bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS is required.
Final-year applicants may satisfy the degree documentation rules conditionally.
Mathematics must cover four subjects totalling 28.5 ECTS, including Calculus, Linear Algebra, Probability and Statistics, and Discrete Mathematics.
Computer Science must cover three subjects totalling 22.5 ECTS, including Object Oriented Programming, Algorithms and Data Structures, and Algorithmic Complexity.
Some compulsory track courses have additional eligibility requirements after enrolment.
English 6 or Level 2 is required and may be met by IELTS 6.5, TOEFL, or eligible previous studies.
Official degree certificates must be submitted.
An official transcript must be submitted.
Proof of English proficiency must be submitted.
A passport copy or identification document must be submitted.
A CV written in English must be submitted.
A motivation letter in English of less than 500 words must be submitted.
Two letters of recommendation must be submitted.
The Computer Science summary sheet must be completed and submitted.
Applicants must pass the selection process.
